g.text: Δ Shannon (bits) by session-step × condition × sex
Grain: animal × trial × session_step (prose: stage-step). Point = median paired Δ Shannon (bits) (right − left session) across 21 kpMS
models; whiskers = ±½ across-model IQR. Kruskal on Δ ~ condition within sex; * = BH q < 0.05 in the 36-cell family. Not Wilcoxon vs 0;
